name: Remember Deduplication
description: Remember operations deduplicate by content hash. No duplicate memories without explicit intent. Same content stored once, referenced many times.
purpose: Prevent memory bloat and ensure data integrity by deduplicating identical content on store, with intentional override for cases where duplicate recording is desired.
acceptanceCriteria: Content hash is computed on every remember operation
Identical content hash returns existing memory reference without duplicate storage
Explicit force flag allows storing duplicate content
Deduplication check is atomic with store operation
Deduplication can be disabled per bank scope
rollback_strategy: Disable deduplication; re-store all memories as individual entries
recovery_strategy: Rebuild content hash index from stored memory content
